g.text: Once, sysadmins kept balance between order and entropy.
But now… your body is gone. Your essence remains—
At the system's heart lurks the
a malignant process feeding on entropy,
rewriting directories into its dominion of chaos.
— proof of what it once was.
Find them with the commands you remember: ls, cat, grep, ps, kill.
